name: io.github.taump/obyte-mcp
title: Obyte MCP
description: Local stdio MCP server for querying Obyte hubs, autonomous agents, balances, units, AA state, AA dry runs, and token symbols.

packageArguments.name: --hub
packageArguments.description: Custom Obyte hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.

packageArguments.name: --token-registry
packageArguments.description: Token registry AA address. Mainnet has a default; testnet symbol lookups need an explicit registry when used.

environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_HUB_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Custom Obyte hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.

environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_TOKEN_REGISTRY_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Token registry AA address for symbol and decimals lookups.
